purpose: Shared voice cast for new Ignite two-voice skits

Narrator.request_shape: generate_audio: model elevenlabs_v4, prompt = the line, dialogue = [{text, voice_type: preset, voice_id}], stability 0.5, similarity_boost 0.75; returns mp3 (44.1 kHz mono)
Narrator.model_decision: Elaine, 2026-11-27: "i changed the voice so in higgsfield u can now see we use eleven labs but i kept arthur". Her own Higgsfield tests that evening used Eleven v4 with Arthur at stability 0.5 and similarity 0.75. Before this the Narrator was seed_audio; episodes recorded with it keep their takes and metadata.
Narrator.pace_note: Arthur reads about 10 to 45% slower on Eleven v4 than on seed_audio: time shots to the real takes.

timing_policy: Use the normal generated speech rate and 1x playback. Time the edit to the finished dialogue; revise the script or extend shots when needed.
